latencia.etiqueta: How long does it take you to fall asleep?
latencia.info: Most people take between 10 and 20 minutes to fall asleep. Less than 5 minutes may be a sign of being very tired, and regularly taking more than 30 minutes may point to trouble falling asleep.
latencia.infoBoton: More about how long it takes to fall asleep

ajuste.explica: If you often wake up groggy even when you time it well, try a slightly longer cycle.

sinJs: The calculator needs JavaScript to work. In the meantime, there’s a table with times already calculated below.

resultados.notaLatencia: We’ve already added the {x} min it takes you to fall asleep.
resultados.explicaRecomendado: We suggest 5 or 6 cycles (7 h 30 min to 9 h), in line with the 7 or more hours that guidelines recommend for adults.

siestas.10: Power nap: it usually clears your head right away.
siestas.18: Short nap: a little breather for the rest of the afternoon.
siestas.25: Long nap: you may need a few minutes to shake off the grogginess.
siestas.90: A full cycle: ideal if you were short on sleep last night.

despedidas: May the night be gentle with you.
Tomorrow is another day; for now, rest.
resultados.acompanarteIntro: If it helps you let go of the day, here’s a guided practice of the same length.

pie.aviso: A gentle guide, not medical advice. If sleep is often hard for you, it’s worth talking it over with a health professional.
pie.instalar: Add it to your home screen
pie.instalarIphone: On iPhone: open the site in Safari, tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.
pie.instalarAndroid: On Android: open the site in Chrome, tap the ⋮ menu, then “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”.
pie.instalarNota: That way it’s one tap away, and it works even without internet.
